svg.title: Error bounds against the scales of the data
svg.text: Error bounds against the scales of the data
ICON-CH1 (1 km reanalysis), bounds of tests/data/icon_ch1_sample.json, 20 dates in different weather situations
97 variables with an error bound; the 18 stored exactly are not shown.
bits per value at the bound;
the grey bar touches the line; the bound buys bytes and no information.
the diamond within a few bounds; the signal per hour drowns in the error.
Each scale divided by the variable's bound
Statistics: 20 dates, the change from 20 pairs with the date before; medians of the non-zero differences.
Encoded: 3 dates, structure tree, k = 1. Share: the row's part of the bytes of all bounded variables.
With levels: one band per family, 13 levels, 50 hPa at the top, 1000 hPa at the bottom
Without level: sorted by the closest of edge difference and change
